# ModelTokens

Namespace `Nfty.Model` in assembly `Nfty.Model`.

```csharp
public static class ModelTokens
```

The text spellings of [`ModelFormat`](Nfty.Model.ModelFormat.md) and [`Pivot`](Nfty.Model.Pivot.md), in one place. The CLI's `--format` / `--pivot` and `set.json`'s `models` block both use these tokens, so the two can never disagree about what a recorded Set was made with.
